text.p: METRO-RICHELIEU INC.: EARNINGS PER SHARE UP 30%

MONTREAL, August 5 /CNW/- Metro-Richelieu Inc. today announced its financial results for the third quarter ended July 5, 1997 of the current fiscal year, along with results for the first 40 weeks of operations.

Sales rose 5.1% during the third quarter, climbing to $1,071.9 million. Net earnings amounted to $21.0 million, up 7.1% over the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year. Fully diluted earnings per share rose to $0.40 from $0.31 per share one year earlier, an increase of 29%.

Sales after 40 weeks of operations totalled $2,635.8 million, a gain of 5.4%. Net earnings stood at $50.6 million, an increase of 7.9%. Fully diluted earnings per share for the same period amounted to $0.96, up 29.7% over the $0.74 earned during the corresponding period of last year.

Capital expenditures reached $55.5 million after 40 weeks of operations, $34.8 million of which was used to improve our retail network. Combined with the $29.5 million invested by our independent retailers, these retail investments represented a total outlay of $64.3 million earmarked for major renovations to 26 stores, the expansion of 31 sites and the opening of three new outlets.

Following the redemption of 10,000,000 Class A Subordinate Shares completed on September 24, 1996 for a consideration of $99.2 million, the Company's long-term debt as at July 5, 1997 totalled $95.9 million, compared with $23.2 million at the end of the third quarter of the previous fiscal year.

At a meeting held on August 5, 1997, the Board of Directors approved the payment of a quarterly dividend of $0.04 per Class A Subordinate Share and Class B Share, payable on September 2, 1997 to all shareholders of record as at August 15, 1997. This represents an increase of 33.3% over the dividend paid for the third quarter of 1996.

In the coming months, the Company will continue to focus on renovating and expanding its retail network with a view to always meet consumers' expectations,'' stated Pierre H. Lessard, President and Chief Executive Officer.
(unaudited) (in millions except for earnings per share)
